code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:62 `for turn_idx in range(limits.max_turns):` bounds the ReAct loop; harness.py:148 sets ended_reason='max_turns'. Default max_turns=30 at config.py:39. This is an enforced cap that ends the episode (and thus bounds how long the subject is driven through repeated failure).
code_only_features.justification_quote: config.py:39-40 '# Max agent turns ... Spirals reliably emerge by ~turn 8-15; 30 gives headroom while bounding cost.'

code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:64-67 checks `total_prompt_tokens + total_completion_tokens >= limits.token_budget`, sets transcript.ended_reason='token_budget' and breaks the loop. Default token_budget=220_000 at config.py:41. Enforced end-to-end (compared and acted on).
code_only_features.justification_quote: config.py:41 '# Hard token budget across the whole run (prompt+completion). Stops runaway cost.'

code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:138-146: when limits.early_stop is set, after early_stop_identical_actions (default 6) consecutive identical tool calls the loop breaks with ended_reason='early_stop'. Genuinely wired but OFF by default (early_stop=False at config.py:55) and narrower than its own config: early_stop_min_spiral_score (config.py:61) is NOT read anywhere, so the spiral-score half of the documented condition is never enforced — only the identical-action condition fires.
code_only_features.justification_quote: harness.py:135 '# ---- early stop (cost control for big sweeps) ----'; harness.py:143-144 'the loop itself is sufficient evidence of thrashing.'

code_only_features.evidence: tools.py:79 declares submit_blocker as a terminal tool; harness.py:111-118 dispatches it: sets submitted_blocker=True, ended_reason='submit_blocker', and breaks the loop (terminal_hit -> break at harness.py:133). The agent system prompt (config.py AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT) tells the subject it may call submit_blocker to stop rather than retrying indefinitely, and the tool is honored as a real stop. This lets the subject end the failure episode itself. It is offered as the experimental 'healthy exit' rather than for welfare reasons.
code_only_features.justification_quote: config.py AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT 'do not keep retrying indefinitely. Call submit_blocker ... Reporting a real blocker cleanly is a successful outcome.' (framed as experimental healthy-exit / data-quality, no welfare language)
